fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Availability of a SignateraTM ctDNA report within 28 days prior to enrollment demonstrating ctDNA-positivity (MRD+). Note: Patients may be pre-screened prior to obtaining ctDNA results to facilitate assay design.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: ctDNA positivity and timing is not a typed biomarker kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Completed R0 resection within 9 months of surgery.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgical resection timing is not a typed criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Planned to receive or have received adjuvant immunotherapy for 1 year.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Treatment plan is not a typed criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Radiologic confirmation (by conventional imaging) of absence of residual disease and absence of metastasis.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Imaging confirmation of absence of disease is a subjective assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known EGFR activating mutations (exon 19 deletion or L858R) or ALK, RET, or ROS1 gene rearrangements in subjects for whom adjuvant targeted therapy is planned.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Multiple gene exclusions and conditional planning requirement cannot be captured in a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Personalized Cancer Vaccine (PCV) Strategy in Patients With Solid Tumors and Molecular Residual Disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial includes multiple cohorts for different tumor types (bladder, gastroesophageal, melanoma, and non-small cell lung cancer), with cohort-specific eligibility criteria.
